test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Given below are four sentences which are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It is a Park quite different from any other we have seen.

B. One difference is that it is made from nearly 250 tons of scrap.

C. Another difference is that it is powered by wind and solar energy.

D. A new Park called Bharat Darshan Park has been thrown open to the public in New Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'DABC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• **Sentence D** will be the first sentence because it is an introductory general statement that tells us about a new park **'Bharat Darshan' **which opened in** New Delhi for the public.**
 
• **Sentence A** will be the first sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• **Sentence B **will be the following sentence because the previous sentence tells us that this park is different from the one we usually see and this sentence tells us that difference.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence C **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence:
 
 
• **D**: A new Park called Bharat Darshan Park has been thrown open to the public in New Delhi.
 
• **A**: It is a Park quite different from any other we have seen.
 
• **B**: One difference is that it is made from nearly 250 tons of scrap.
 
• **C**: Another difference is that it is powered by wind and solar energy.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *A new Park called Bharat Darshan Park has been thrown open to the public in New Delhi. It is a Park quite different from any other we have seen. One difference is that it is made from nearly 250 tons of scrap. Another difference is that it is powered by wind and solar energy.*
